title: devctl project config
description: How devctl runs this project (.devctl.yaml, and .devctl.local.yaml on top of it). devctl reads it only when the project_config_enabled setting is on. A key that is not set leaves that site value alone.

php.description: PHP version of the site, for example "8.4".

node.description: Node.js version. devctl writes it to .nvmrc. Use 22, 20.11.1, lts/*, lts/iron, or a range like >=20.

public_dir.description: Web root inside the project, for example public. Empty for the project root.

cors.description: Add permissive CORS headers to every response.

spx.description: Turn on the SPX profiler for the site.

aliases.description: Extra host names for the site, for example www.myapp.test or *.myapp.test.

workers.description: Workers devctl runs for the site. devctl adds the workers that are missing and removes the ones not listed.

command.description: Shell command of a custom worker.

services.description: Services the project needs. devctl shows the missing ones on the site with an install action. It does not install them by itself.
